name: veyq-site
//: The published documentation (ADR 0087): Use, Run and Security, built by Astro + Starlight to static files in dist/. Deliberately OUTSIDE the root npm workspace, with its own package-lock.json: the workspace exists for @veyq/crypto alone, and the site shares no code with web/ or admin-web/. Installed through the same deprecated-package gate as every npm package: `python3 scripts/npm_ci_no_deprecated.py --package-dir site` from the repo root.
//engines: The Node the site's tree supports: astro >=22.12.0 and postcss-nested 8 (the override below) ^22.0.0 || ^24.0.0 || >=26.0.0, so an odd, non-LTS release such as 23 is outside it. CI runs Node 22, as for the root workspace.
//overrides: postcss-nested: @astrojs/starlight -> astro-expressive-code -> @expressive-code/core@0.44.2 asks postcss-nested ^6.0.1, whose 6.2.0 pins postcss-selector-parser ^6.1.1 - and every postcss-selector-parser below 7.1.6 carries GHSA-rj75-hqrm-r3gf (quadratic selector parsing, CPU exhaustion). npm audit's own fix is a downgrade of Starlight to 0.21. The path only parses expressive-code's own CSS at build time, so it is unreachable from content, but a knowingly-vulnerable dependency is not something we keep (root package.json //overrides). postcss-nested 8 depends on postcss-selector-parser ^7.1.4. Drop this once @expressive-code/core asks for postcss-nested >= 7.
